main_topics.reason: The user asked whether psoriasis patches itch more at night, why that happens, and what might help.
The user said they wake up having scratched their skin raw and considered covering the knee with cotton.
The user asked whether greasy ointment works better than regular cream and received an overnight-versus-daytime comparison.

output.summary: The user asked about nighttime itching from psoriasis patches on their elbows and one knee, and said they sometimes wake with the skin scratched raw. The assistant suggested a cooler bedroom, ointment before bed, short nails, and a loose cotton layer over the knee; the user said they got what they needed and planned to try the suggestions.
